_comment: WHITELIST. Only repos listed here can ever appear on the profile.
Activity decides the ORDER; this file decides what is publishable at all.
A repo you push to that is not listed here is silently skipped -- so a new
private experiment can never leak onto your profile by default.
Key   = owner/repo exactly as GitHub spells it. Check the owner: some live
under the GoodStuffSoftware org and some under the personal account,
and a key with the wrong owner silently never matches -- the project
just never appears, with no error.
label = what the world sees. For a private repo make this say what it IS
blurb = one short line. Keep it under ~80 chars or the table wraps badly.
link  = optional. Omit for a private repo unless the link points at the
PRODUCT rather than the repo -- a 404 link looks broken.
_unresolved: Simple Tile (simpletile.goodstuff.software) has no repository on either the
personal account or the GoodStuffSoftware org, so it cannot be whitelisted.
It is not in the goodstuffsoftware monorepo or gs-services either. It still
appears in the static 'What I make' table in README.md, which is enough.
When it gets a repo, add the real key here -- do not guess one.
